summary: Iteration 9 frontend-only test: Edit-mode toggle + Table 'Observation' (Photos removed) verified end-to-end. Admin sees edit-mode-toggle (default OFF); with edit OFF both Tiles and Table are read-only (no inline inputs, R/I/P badges only, supplier-name span, observation-text truncated to 41 chars with ellipsis and full text in title attribute). With edit ON, all fields (supplier-dropdown, status-select, pallet-input, invoice-input, observation-input, and toggle-recorded/invoice/price switches) are inline-editable in BOTH views. Persistence confirmed via PUT /api/receivals/<id> and page reload: pallet=77, invoice=INV-TEST-9 (auto-ticked Invoice received), observation edit, and priceChecked toggle all persisted. Table headers = [Date, Supplier, Status, Received by, Invoice #, Observation, Slips, Pallets, Checklist, Actions] — no 'Photos' column, Observation column present. Staff (PIN 1234) has NO edit-mode toggle/switch and NO inline inputs in either view; only R/I/P badges + View action.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceivalListPage.js is 839 lines — consider splitting into TilesView.js, TableView.js and shared hooks (persistField, setLocal) for maintainability.
editMode state is not persisted (resets to OFF on reload). Not required per spec, but consider storing in localStorage like viewMode for better UX.
Read-only supplier/status/observation rely on plain spans; ensure sufficient color contrast for '—' placeholders (muted-foreground on white).
seed_data_creation: Modified existing Global Produce Co receival (id bbf657ff-6902-4561-811d-ef275e34ba37): palletCount=77, invoiceNumber=INV-TEST-9, observation=TEST_iter9_obs, priceChecked=false. Restored one other observation to 'staff created' after truncation test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only 4 receivals exist (spec mentioned ~11 — data may have been cleaned in an earlier iteration; not blocking). view-toggle buttons do NOT have per-button data-testids — use button[title='Table view'] / button[title='Tiles view']. Login redirects to '/' not '/receivals' (list is on root). Field name on frontend is palletCount but backend serializes as palletsReceived — beware when reading API dumps.
